prompt: Create one photorealistic editorial photograph for the hero of a minimalist European wild-food foraging website. Portrait 4:5 composition. Extreme ground-level close-up of a small cluster of golden chanterelle mushrooms growing naturally in richly textured soft green moss, brown fallen beech leaves, and damp forest earth. A real woodland scene with beautiful imperfect forms, delicate ridges beneath the curved caps, tiny soil particles. Gentle early morning side light catches the golden caps, deep forest green background softly out of focus. High-end outdoor magazine photography, full-frame camera, 85mm macro lens, natural color, realistic photographic texture, quiet cinematic atmosphere. Mushroom cluster sits center-right and occupies about 50 percent of frame; hints of woodland recede behind it. No illustration, no comic style, no studio cutout, no fake bokeh circles, no glowing mushrooms, no hands, no text, no border, no logos. This is an atmospheric marketing image, not an identification diagram.
purpose: Photorealistic marketing illustration; not species-identification evidence
